newsitem.title: USA: Unifi Inc to buy Spanco Yarns.
newsitem.headline: Unifi Inc to buy Spanco Yarns.

text.p: Unifi Inc said Monday that it had signed a letter of intent to purchase Spanco Yarns, a manufacturer of covered yarns.
In a press release, Unifi said the purchase is subject to due diligence and the execution of a definitive agreement.
"The acquisition of Spanco Yarns complements and strengthens our existing nylon and covered yarn operations," said William Kretzer, president and chief executive officer in the release.
"This purchase demonstrates our continued commitment to expand our product and service capabilities to the hosiery, apparel and narrow fabric industries, domestically and internationally," he said.
